name: @maxgfr/ultrai18n
description: Find every human-readable string in a repository, classify it, translate it with cheap models, and prove nothing was missed.
author: maxgfr

scripts.check:build: pnpm build && git diff --exit-code -- skills/ultrai18n/scripts && node scripts/sync-engine.mjs --check && node scripts/verify-engine-usage.mjs
scripts.engine:prepare: pnpm run build && pnpm bench --ci && node scripts/check-artifact-recall.mjs
scripts.engine:gate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:build && pnpm run eval && pnpm bench --ci && git diff --exit-code -- bench/REPORT.md bench/report.json && node skills/ultrai18n/scripts/ultrai18n.mjs census --repo . --json > /dev/null
